description: Where the montages of nemar.sensor-labels.v1 come from. Each file holds the electrode positions MNE-Python returns for one built-in montage, times scale_to_m, rounded to 9 decimal places of a meter. Every montage is RAS: +x toward the right preauricular point, +y toward the nasion, +z up.

upstream.FieldTrip: FieldTrip template/electrode/standard_1005.elc: 10-05 positions constructed by Robert Oostenveld (Oostenveld and Praamstra 2001, The five percent electrode system for high-resolution EEG and ERP measurements), in millimeters in Montreal Neurological Institute (MNI) coordinates on FieldTrip's template head (Colin27). The FieldTrip repository is GPL-3.0 and its website CC BY-SA 4.0; neither states a license for the template electrode files. MNE-Python ships the file under its BSD-3-Clause license.
upstream.EGI: Electrical Geodesics, Inc. (EGI) HydroCel Geodesic Sensor Net layouts. FieldTrip states its template/electrode/GSN-HydroCel-*.sfp files were downloaded from the EGI FTP server, and MNE-Python's montage README says its GSN-HydroCel files are taken from FieldTrip. MNE's files hold the same numbers as FieldTrip's (FieldTrip names the 64 and 65 nets without _1.0); the bytes differ in whitespace. No license is stated for the layouts by EGI or FieldTrip; MNE-Python ships them under BSD-3-Clause.
upstream.BioSemi: BioSemi head cap layouts (ABC labels, A1 to H32), as spherical angles in MNE-Python's biosemi*.txt. MNE's montage README does not name their origin. BioSemi publishes the position coordinates of its standard head caps (biosemi.com/download/Cap_coords_all.xls, linked from biosemi.com/headcap.htm) with no license statement; they were not compared with MNE's files. MNE-Python ships them under BSD-3-Clause.

montages.name: standard_1005
notes: MNE-Python 1.13 renamed the standard_1005 montage colin27_1005 (standard_1005 is deprecated and leaves in MNE 1.14); it reads the same file, in meters in MNI coordinates, unscaled.

montages.name: GSN-HydroCel-32
notes: head_size=None keeps the net file's own geometry, in centimeters, so each net and its Cz variant (64 and 65, 128 and 129, 256 and 257) share their electrode positions exactly; MNE's default rescales each file by its own median radius, which moves the 64/65 and 256/257 pairs apart by up to 0.14 mm.

montages.name: biosemi128
notes: MNE places the caps on a sphere of head_size, its default 0.095 m; the spherical layout has no head size of its own.

MNE-Python reads the angles in this file as integers, so an angle written with a decimal (11.5) becomes 11: 66 of 128 electrodes sit up to 1.083 mm from where the angles as written put them. The positions here are MNE's.
